title: fix(app-shell): zh-CN Studio first screens stop mixing English in the package form, flow rail groups and column picker
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb895hQJRzcYb4LCvShTxE6L)_

Fixes #29706

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are the amended claim's (comment on the card, 2026-11-03T02:55Z).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：中文 Studio 的三处首屏不再夹英文。新建软件包表单在中文词表加载后重建，标签和说明都是中文；自动化侧栏里尚未发布的对象，其流程分组显示对象标签（如「维修工单」），不再显示大写的机器名；列表视图的「添加字段」先列搭建者自己的字段，再列系统字段（创建时间、创建人、所有人等）。
- 为什么改：这些是中文用户最先看到的界面，中英混杂让人分不清哪些字可以忽略。卡上的第一行（「新建类似」复制流程后的提示句）要服务端先给出代码，已移到服务端车道的卡 #29727，本 PR 不动它。
- 风险与回滚：只改 app-shell 的三处读取与排序，不加不删 i18n 键，不动 spec 与 runtime。草稿对象多读一次草稿列表，失败时照旧只用已发布对象。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 `readObjectLabels`（合并草稿对象的标签）；`PackageFormDialog.tsx` 的表单 memo 依赖；`ViewColumnPanes.tsx` 的 `AddFieldPopover` 排序。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.lazyCatalogue-29706.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.draftObjectFlowGroup-29706.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FieldsListEditor.addFieldOrder-29706.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件 6 个用例全过（任一修复撤回时对应用例转红）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The card's four rows were re-measured on `main` 7b55ea95 in zh-CN, and all four reproduced. Rows 2 to 4 are fixed here. Row 1 moved to its own card (below).

- **Row 1, the New similar clone notice: moved to #29727, not changed here.** The flow clone answer is `{flow, packageId, notice}` with no code, and the console prints `notice` as sent. The repo's pattern for a server sentence a person reads is code-keyed: the console maps a code it knows to an i18n key and keeps the wire text for any other code (`translateFailureCode` in `CloudConnectionPanel.tsx`; the publish refusal's `BATCH_ABORTED_CODE` line in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`). The notice has no code yet, so the first step is server-side (`packages/runtime`), which is out of this card's surface. #29727 covers the flow and permission-set clone notices and the console mapping that follows the code.
- **Row 2, the New package form (`PackageFormDialog.tsx`).** Studio's landing mounts the dialog closed, before the lazily fetched zh `studio` catalogue is resident. The form spec (labels and help lines, `getPackageForm`) was memoised on `[locale, mode]`, so the `en` answer of the first render survived the catalogue's arrival, while the title, read on every render, turned Chinese: 新建软件包 over "Display name" and "Human-readable package name". The memo now also keys on `isStudioCatalogueLoaded(locale)`, so the form is rebuilt once the catalogue lands. Once rebuilt, zh no longer falls through to the spec's `.describe()` text; en still does, by design (`add10d8f9`).
- **Row 3, the Automations rail (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `readObjectLabels` only).** The rail's object index read the published objects only, so a flow started on an object not published yet was grouped under the object's name, which the header's `uppercase` style showed as REPAIRS_REPAIR_TICKET. The index now merges the package's object drafts (`listDrafts({ packageId, type: 'object' })`, unscoped in the package-less scope) with the label each `_drafts` row carries, resolved in the designer locale. A published object keeps its published label. A failed draft read adds nothing and leaves the published index as it was.
- **Row 4, the column picker (`ViewColumnPanes.tsx`, `AddFieldPopover`).** The served object puts the columns `applySystemFields` injects ahead of the author's field map. Measured on `@objectstack/objectql`'s `applySystemFields` for an object declaring `title` and `priority`: `organization_id`, `created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by`, `owner_id`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue`, `title`, `priority`. The list-view inspector already drops the hidden ones, but the audit four and `owner_id` stayed on top. The picker now lists the builder's fields first and the `system` ones after, each in served order. The same popover serves the report inspector's columns.
- No i18n key is added or removed, and nothing under `packages/spec` or `packages/runtime` changes.

## Tests

Three new files, one per kept row, each over the real component, each with a CONTROL case.

- **`PackageFormDialog.lazyCatalogue-29706.test.tsx`.** Mounts the real `PackageFormDialog` closed under an `I18nProvider` in zh with the studio catalogue NOT resident (asserted first; the `dom` project isolates each file), lands the catalogue, then opens it, as Studio's landing does. The labels and help read 显示名称 / 软件包的可读名称。 and neither "Display name" nor the spec's `.describe()` text appears (read from the installed `ManifestSchema`). CONTROL: an en console mounted the same way keeps the spec's own English help.
- **`StudioDesignSurface.draftObjectFlowGroup-29706.test.tsx`.** The whole surface at `/studio/PKG/automations` (harness of `automationsRailOrder-12612`): one published object, one draft-only object whose `_drafts` header carries 维修工单, one flow on each. The draft object's group reads 维修工单 and not its machine name. CONTROL: the published object's group reads its published label.
- **`FieldsListEditor.addFieldOrder-29706.test.tsx`.** The real `FieldsListEditor` and its Add field popover over a catalog in the measured served order (audit four and `owner_id` first). The picker lists `title`, `priority`, then the system columns in served order. CONTROL: a catalog with no system column keeps its served order.
- **Ablations, one per row** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, fix committed first, each mutation counted on disk and restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): memo deps back to `[locale, mode]`; the draft read replaced by an empty answer; the picker order back to `[...fields]`. Each turns exactly its row's case red and leaves the CONTROL green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Row 1 went to #29727** (filed by the seat for the server lane). This PR leaves the clone notice as it is.
- **Measured live, before and after, in zh-CN** (app-crm `--fresh` backend plus the Vite console on source; before = the three `origin/main` source files swapped in, restored to HEAD after): the rail header read REPAIRS_REPAIR_TICKET before and 维修工单 after; the New package form's first labels read "Display name", "Description", 软件包 ID, "Object namespace" before and 显示名称, 描述, 软件包 ID, 对象命名空间 after; the column picker read 创建时间, 创建人, 更新时间, 更新人, 负责人, 标题, 优先级 before and 标题, 优先级, then the five system columns after. Screenshots are in the project's `issue-29706/` folder (`before-row*.png`, `after-row*.png`). The harness was temporary and nothing of it is committed.
- **Seen on the same screens, not changed here (outside this card's surface):** the filter builder's "+ Add filter…" in the Interfaces list-view panel renders in English in zh-CN; the package form's Type select shows the raw value `app`; the dialog's screen-reader "Close" label is English. Noted for triage.
- After merging `main` (the pinyin create-door card landed in `PackageFormDialog.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`), the touched suites, the app-shell type-check and the three new files were re-run on the merged head.

## Verification

Final head `f9fd4b39` (merge of `origin/main` 3eeb81d1); code head a346e17d.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- The 3 new files: 3 files, 6 tests passed (merged head).
- Every app-shell test naming `PackageFormDialog`, `ViewColumnPanes`, `FieldsListEditor`, `AddFieldPopover`, `BuilderLanding` or the Automations rail (125 files, code head a346e17d's tree, `--maxWorkers=2`, three batches): 125 files, 1080 tests passed. On the merged head, the 36 that name the touched components plus the two rail suites: 38 files, 304 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 65 of 65 tasks successful (merged head).
- `pnpm exec eslint` over the six touched ui files: 0 errors (existing warnings only).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 170 files passed, 2 skipped; 4977 tests passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 35 derived families (unchanged by the merge). The 34 non-vitest ones ran in one loop on a346e17d and all exited 0, including `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:published-files`, `check:type-check-debt` (locked) and `check:cross-package-test-inputs`; the 35th, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, is the run above. The body-reading gates were re-run on this body before opening.
- `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` reads the changeset as `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the amended claim. No i18n key and no export changes.
- Dogfood battery: n/a, because there is no `!` in the title and no (narrowing) arm.

</details>
